record.title: Return to the exact browse position after playback
record.problem: The player’s visible Library action returns Home; a long loaded catalog can also lose its extent after a back navigation that misses cache.
record.proposed_behavior: Add a visible 'Back to Movies/Shows/search' action with a safe same-origin return context; restore sort/query/loaded extent/focused title when browser history cache cannot do it.
record.current_state: There is already scroll/focus restoration for matching cards and browser back/forward. It stores href plus scroll only, and only selected card shapes are captured. Player’s Library link is href='/'. This is completion of the existing return feature.

evidence.observation: sessionStorage ... { href: link.getAttribute('href'), scroll: scrollY }; ... focus ... scrollTo
append incoming cards and replace next page link

risks.regression: Avoid reopening playback on Back, duplicate card loads, restoring a scroll position before cards exist, or clobbering browser history.
risks.security: Validate bounded same-origin return paths; never honor arbitrary URL redirects.
risks.privacy: Keep browse state profile-scoped and tab-local; avoid sensitive query retention beyond the session.
risks.ip: No new gesture or miniplayer behavior proposed.

dependencies: Show wrapper and resumed-card focus coverage
record.confidence_note: level: high; rationale: A return feature exists but does not persist loaded extent, and the visible player link goes Home. Cache-miss behavior requires runtime validation.; benefit: medium; prioritization is an audit judgment, not measured household usage
record.validation_gap: No fresh runtime reproduction or user study in this audit.
